headline: Pierrakakis: Triple Intervention in September on Income, Private Debt and Investment - Dnews
summary: Minister Kyriakos Pierrakakis announced three interventions for September focused on disposable income, private debt and attracting international investment funds.
why: Income support, household debt relief and foreign investment inflows are key drivers of Greek domestic demand and sovereign credit perception.
